post.description:
Run the reference solution on every test input and save its output as the expected
output. Also measures the slowest run and sets the automatic time limit. Nothing is
saved if the reference solution fails on any test.

ML questions: add one train/test split as a test case. The test labels are kept
on the server and never sent to students or to the sandbox.
The reference solution must pass every test. Exams refuse to open otherwise.

Run any code against all tests, e.g. a deliberately wrong or slow solution, to
check the tests are strong enough to catch it.

schema.title: Response List Exams Api V1 Subjects  Subject Id  Exams Get

get.description: Everything that would stop the exam from opening, checked without opening it.

post.description:
Open the exam and create its access code. Show the code in the lab; students
need it to start, so nobody can begin from outside the room or before you say so.
Replace the access code, e.g. if it was shared outside the room.
End the exam for everyone: unfinished sessions are submitted with their saved code.
Re-run final grading, e.g. after fixing a wrong test. Manual marks are kept.

get.description:
Every enrolled student's status. For instant updates open the live WebSocket
instead of polling (POST /exams/{id}/live-ticket, then /exams/{id}/live).

post.description:
Let a locked student continue. Optionally add time (after a false alarm) and move
the session to a new laptop if they switched devices.

End this student's exam now. Their saved code is submitted and graded; any
misconduct penalty is decided separately by the professor.

put.description:
Manual marks (e.g. for logic in half-written code) or a full override. Every change
is kept in the audit log with the old and new values.

get.description: Marks per student. Filter by batch (division) or by the language students answered in.

schema.title: Response Results Api V1 Exams  Exam Id  Results Get

get.description:
Every saved answer of an exam with its code and marks, for checking answers one
after another. Filter by language, batch and question.

post.description:
A one-time ticket to open the live monitor WebSocket (browsers cannot send the
Authorization header on a WebSocket). Valid for 30 seconds and for one connection.

Called once per laptop. The app proves it holds the private key by signing
'AEGIS-REGISTER-V1\n<user id>\n<public key>'.

schema.title: Response My Exams Api V1 Student Exams Get

post.description:
Start the exam (needs the access code shown in the lab), or rejoin it after a
crash. Rejoining from a different laptop locks the session until a professor
approves the switch.

put.description: Autosave. Call every few seconds while the student types.

post.description: Run against the visible sample tests.

Check against all tests. Final marks always use the latest saved code when the
exam ends, so students can keep improving after submitting.

Every 10-15 s. Tells the monitor the student is connected and returns the
authoritative status and time left (the app should show the server's countdown).

The app reports anything suspicious it detects or blocks. Minor events add a
strike; reaching the limit or any severe event locks the session at once.

Student hands in. Their latest saved code for each question becomes final, and
they get a receipt hash per answer as proof of what was submitted.

Selection.title: Selection
Selection.description:
How each student's questions are picked from the exam pool.

mode "random": for each rule, pick `count` random questions matching it (e.g. one
easy, one medium, one hard). Every student gets the same difficulty mix but a
different paper. mode "fixed": everyone gets the whole pool, in shuffled order.
